snippet.title: Nimbit Frontier - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Nimbit Frontier is a creature-collecting life-sim where you venture into the mysterious wilderness and return home to build habitats for creatures called Nimbits. You hatch the chicks by implanting their genetics into donor eggs, and care for them until they are ready for release into the wild.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2477710/Nimbit_Frontier/

Meet the Dev (Megasploot)
Website: https://nimbitfrontier.com/
X: https://x.com/Megasploot

#indiegame #lifesim #creaturecollector
